newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM growth lifts Schiphol August cargo.
newsitem.headline: KLM growth lifts Schiphol August cargo.

text.p: Airfreight handled at Schiphol airport in August showed an unexpectedly higher year-on-year increase of 16.5 percent, the airport operating company said.
It added in a statement that 83,894 tonnes of airfreight were handled reflecting an increase in freight-related activity by KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV.
A KLM spokesman told Reuters by telephone that the airline does not usually break down its activities on a monthly basis, other than to provide a short monthly statement.
He added that overall the airline's cargo wing carried nine percent more freight in August.
He said "The market recovered somewhat and traffic recovered and we hope this is a continuing trend. I cannot give more details at this time."
Schiphol said charter passenger traffic was static, and it had noticed that a tail-off in the number Dutch holidaymakers travelling through the airport.
Non-Dutch travellers, and business traffic for Dutch and international passengers market segments are still growing, it said.
